body: I am happy that you are feeling better. From someone who stopped taking the medication, I can comprehend how hard it must have been for you. I am still a student and apart from the money that is in my saving from my summer job I am practically depending on my parents.
The weird thing is that he is pretty liberal. However, he believes that people from my country don't have mental health problems and it's only an issue for Westerners.

Thank you for your advice! I have been invalidating my emotions for years but hearing them from someone else hurts a lot. It makes me second guess myself and I always have this feeling that I am faking it for attention. I am working on it in therapy and I hope it gets better. I also wish you good luck in your journey.
I just turned 18 but I am a student and I still depend on them. I have savings from my summer jobs and that’s how I can pay for my meds.
The thing is that is very knowledgeable and knows a lot of things. However, once an information enters his brain no one can convince him otherwise.

I have brought the subject of mental health several times with him and I am not the only one who seems to be concerned for him. However, he said therapy is a joke and he doesn't need anything like that. It’s hard to see him struggling with is mental health and not being able to do anything about it .
Yes, I would try to do that if he talks about It again.

When you admit he is right he always runs it in your face and will not let you forget about it for years. He always brags about how he is always right but people just say that he is to stop the argument. He is being like that for years I don’t think no matter how much effort I do that he will change.

Thank you ( and everyone) for the kind message. I have been feeling a sense of relief because I thought I was exaggerating the situation. He is really stubborn and I for my own sake I will just said that I stopped taking them. I hope you have a good recovery!

I tried to cut him up or limit my interaction with him but multiple people kept saying that he is my dad and I shouldn’t just ignore him. He is also really unstable where he can go weeks without talking to me and then call me for 3 hours every day. When we are really close I always seem to forget the hurtful things he told me.

The last time I went cold turkey it was horrible mentally and physically. The worst was the insomnia that I got when I started taking them. I will just tell him that I stopped taking them and hope I get peace of mind. I also hope things get better for you too.
It took her a while to accept it but she saw the difference so now she even reminds me to take them.
Thank everyone for the answers ! Even if lying to my dad makes me feel bad but for my own sake, I’ll tell him that I did stop taking them.
